sources.citation: Vaz, Christopher. 2005. A Functional Grammar Sketch of Hill Madia. SIL Electronic Working Papers 2005-014. 31 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request); access check: open copy online; the open copy could not be downloaded when a reader tried
sources.note: Only modern sketch; may have a one-paragraph phonology note. sil.org blocks automated download (not reachable by automated download); the Internet Archive lacks the PDF.
Segmental inventory only; no stress statement. Its reference list supplied the Natarajan 1981 and Pandey 1979 Shodhganga handles.

sources.citation: Natarajan, G. V. 1985. Abujhmaria Grammar. (CIIL Grammar Series 14.) Mysore: Central Institute of Indian Languages. 353 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request); access check: open copy online
sources.note: Silent. Ch. 2 Phonology (pp. 32-85) covers phonetic correlates, phonemic contrasts, allophony, distribution, clusters, syllable structure, 'transition features' (juncture 2.9.1; clause terminals 2.9.2: falling/rising/level pitch) and free variation; no section or sentence on word stress/accent. Both scanned layers (ABBYY, Adobe text layer) have zero hits for stress/accent/suprasegmental. Only prosodic remarks: word-final vowels always phonetically half-long (p. 36); word-initial consonants fortis, medial/final lenis (p. 37).
